verdict.rationale: SendGrid is API-first, so it runs headlessly by design. The docs cover a REST v3 Mail Send API, key-based auth read from an environment variable (process.env.SENDGRID_API_KEY), cURL and official SDK quickstarts, and SMTP. Sandbox mode validates Mail Send requests without delivering mail, which suits automated test pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance, an official CLI for scripted account or config management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
